source.name: About FIBA: "Driving the game forward: FIBA welcomes Jetour as its Official Car Supplier"
source.quote: FIBA is pleased to announce a new global partnership with Jetour, which will serve as its Official Car Supplier.

note: FIBA's Official Car Supplier (FIBA also calls it a Global Supplier), ahead of the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 in Qatar.
